description:
Paul White returns with his first official release since 2018’s ‘Rejuvenate’ album, which saw him abandon sampling altogether to write, perform and produce his own take on psychedelic pop music. Since then he has been writing and producing for a number of high profile artists including singer and violinist Sudan Archives, and regular collaborator Danny Brown for his recent album uknowhatimsayin¿.“Smile (See The Light)”, featuring London based songstress Iyamah and Australian rapper Remi, is Paul White at his most joyful and a welcome spirited song in difficult times.

“When Iyamah and i first started working on the song quite a while ago we knew pretty much from the get-go that we wanted a rapper like Remi on it. I first met Remi back in Golden Rules days and i’m pleased being able to bring two such wonderful people together on a track of mine.”
credits:
Music by Iyamah & Paul White 
Lyrics by Iyamah & REMI
Produced by Paul White 
Recorded in the UK & Australia
Mixed by Tom Leach at Pony Studio
Mastered by Katie Tavini at the Weird Jungle
Artwork by LM & Ciaran Chapple-Canty
